text:
Rae Kim: Quick heads-up 1 activation queue is backlogged for a small set of new tenants after a concurrency change in the onboarding worker. Some trials stalled and 2 customers are in a renewal window. Need a short customer note + AE playbook.

Jonah Patel: How many tenants and ETA to clear?

Rae Kim: 8 tenants impacted. Backfill will run once we revert the concurrency tweak; ETA restore ~75 minutes, smaller jobs may be replayed sooner.

Marta Ruiz: CS ops plan: (1) short proactive message to all affected tenants, (2) prioritized 1:1 outreach for the 2 renewal accounts with offer for an assisted activation and a goodwill gesture, (3) AE one-pager with impacted job IDs and suggested credit language.

Eric Wu: Draft customer blurb below. Keep it concise for engineering teams.

```
Hi [Customer],

We detected intermittent activation delays for certain onboarding jobs. Engineers traced this to a recent concurrency change in our onboarding worker and are reverting the change now. We expect normal activation traffic to resume within ~75 minutes and will prioritize replaying any stalled jobs.

What were doing:
- Reverting the recent concurrency change and running a prioritized backfill.
- Offering assisted activation for customers who prefer hands-on help.
- Evaluating eligibility for credits under your agreement; your account team will follow up to confirm.

Next steps: your CS lead will reach out with an update and to schedule any assistance. You can follow the incident at <status.redwood.ai/inc/INC-2026-4811>.

D Eric, Customer Success
```

Jules Martin (Legal): Approved. Keep the initial message high-level and avoid dollar amounts. Use the legal line exactly as written about credit evaluation.

Rae Kim: Jonah, can your team own the 1:1s for the renewal cohort? Please use the AE one-pager script and record outcomes in the CS tracker (accepted assistance, requested credits, renewal risk update).

Jonah Patel: Yep D will take the renewal outreach and block slots for assisted activations tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-4811 created (priority: medium). Postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:00 AM PT.

Marta Ruiz: I'll assemble the AE one-pager and the short feedback form link to capture any stuck job IDs and sample errors. Share with Jonah after legal ack and I'll push the general note after that. :white_check_mark:
